$comment: Blueprints and builder NPCs (WORK_QUEUE item 56, docs/BLUEPRINTS.md): a placed structure shown as ghost blocks, built by players holding Place and by builder NPCs. `limits`: the most blueprints a world holds (`perWorld`). `player`: one piece every `paceMs` while Place is held aiming into a blueprint, the panel's most block rows (`panelRows`). `ghost`: the most ghost faces drawn per blueprint (`faceCap`). `builder`: the creature that builds (`creature`, shared/creatures), one piece every `paceS` seconds with unlimited blocks, standing within `reachM` of its cell to place it, spawned at a blueprint with a player within `nearM` m and none of its builders yet (at most `perBlueprint`). `catalog`: the repository's blueprints offered in the Blueprints list (structure names, shared/structures). Run `node shared/blueprints/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/blueprints.gen.rs is stale. `towns` (B4): town sites per face from the world seed, one at most per `spacingM` grid cell at a seeded point within `jitter` × half a cell of its centre (`attempts` points tried in order, the first that suits), on dry land `heightM` [min, max] m above sea level whose ground rises at most `maxSlopeDeg` across `footprintM`; founded (its plan's blueprints placed, each on the ground under its anchor) once a living player is within `foundM` m and its ground is loaded. A plan (`plans`, picked by `weight` per site): its blueprints, each a structure, its anchor's offset from the site `at` [x, z] m and its `turn` (quarter turns). `towns.map`: how the big map and the minimap show the sites (docs/BLUEPRINTS.md §6, docs/MAP_MARKERS.md filters): `reveal` (`explored`: a site shows once its ground is explored; `all`), its vector `icon` (shared/ui/markers.json), `color` (a site) and `buildingColor` (founded, blueprints still standing), `iconPx`, `clusterPx` (icons nearer merge with a count), `siteMsPerDraw` (the most a draw spends siting new cells). `builder.job` names the job its builders do (`jobs`, B5, docs/BLUEPRINTS.md §9): a job's `kind` (`build`: take what its blueprint needs next from the town's storehouse, carry it to the site, place it, walk back; `haul` and `fell`, the carters' and foresters', are later phases), `carryMax` the most items one carries, `mixedLoads` whether one load may hold several blocks (the next cells' blocks, in build order), `waitS` how long one waits at a storehouse that lacks what it needs before looking again. `storehouse` (B5): a town plan's blueprint with `role` `storehouse` is built first (by its builders from their own hands, as B3's), then holds the town's materials: its `stock` (`unlimited` for now: it gives whatever is asked and keeps whatever is put; a counted stock comes with harvesting), the blueprints within `rangeM` m of it fetch from it (none near: B3's unlimited builders), and a builder within `reachM` m of its box takes or puts. `carryLook`: how a carried load shows on an NPC's back: the characters item `item` (shared/characters, its socket's bone placed per piece) drawn once per piece at the model's `joint`, `at` [x, y, z] m from it in the body's frame (+z ahead, +y up), in layers of `perLayer` pieces `pieceM` m a side, rising with the count; `kinds` per block name override `pieceM` and `perLayer` (logs carried bigger).
